propositions: Establish nested `rebar bridge` CLI with functional `preview` (read-only) and `sync` (mutating) verbs as a shippable vertical slice
Preview forces dry-run mode and performs zero Jira writes or state mutations; sync forces live mode and persists mutations while preserving unrelated state
Reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and arbitrary trailing arguments to prevent callers from overriding the read/write distinction between preview and sync
Unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never fall through to same-named top-level commands; help output is sanitized of internal vocabulary
Legacy top-level commands (`reconcile`, `jira-onboard`, `bridge-probe`, `bridge-fsck`, `doctor`) retain unchanged behavior and routing paths
Generated documentation and CLI reference are updated to describe only the staged nested group surface that ships
